<!--
  CPMS chiller plant SCADA, 3D view.
  Drop-in replacement for the 2D Grafana HTML panel fragment (style + markup + script, no <html>/<head>).
  - Telemetry: same WebSocket + plant-state payload as the 2D panel (${cpms_telemetry_ws_url}).
  - Rendering: three.js r128 (UMD). Loaded from window.CPMS_THREE_URL if set, else cdnjs.
    If the dashboard host can't reach cdnjs, self-host three.min.js and set window.CPMS_THREE_URL.
  - Demo data: runs automatically outside Grafana when no telemetry arrives, or force with ?cpmsDemo=1.
-->
<style>
.cpms3d {
  --cwr: #f08b45;
  --cws: #2fbcc1;
  --chws: #4a95e6;
  --chwr: #e9506a;
  --bypass: #9a5ce6;
  --run: #3fbf7f;
  --warn: #e3a43a;
  --bad: #ef5a5a;
  --info: #5aa7ef;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 420px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}
.cpms3d *, .cpms3d *::before, .cpms3d *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

.cpms3d.theme-dark {
  --bg: #0e1217;
  --panel: rgba(20, 25, 32, 0.88);
  --panel-solid: #161b22;
  --line: #2d3742;
  --line-strong: #46525f;
  --text: #dde2e7;
  --text-2: #9ba6b2;
  --muted: #69737e;
  --standby: #6b7480;
  --chip: #232a33;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
}
.cpms3d.theme-light {
  --bg: #e9edf1;
  --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  --panel-solid: #ffffff;
  --line: #d3d9df;
  --line-strong: #aab4be;
  --text: #17202a;
  --text-2: #4d5a67;
  --muted: #84909c;
  --standby: #8a949e;
  --chip: #eef1f4;
  --run: #23955c;
  --warn: #b97a12;
  --bad: #d23c3c;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
}

.cpms3d .stage { position: absolute; inset: 0; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; }
.cpms3d .stage.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }
.cpms3d .stage.hovering { cursor: pointer; }
.cpms3d .stage canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; outline: none; }

.cpms3d .tags { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; z-index: 2; }

/* ───────── floating panels ───────── */
.cpms3d .hud {
  position: absolute;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  z-index: 5;
}

.cpms3d .status-strip {
  top: 12px; left: 12px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  padding: 4px;
}
.cpms3d .status-strip > div {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--chip);
  font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;
}
.cpms3d .sdot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--standby); flex: none; }
.cpms3d .plant-status.normal .sdot { background: var(--run); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--run); }
.cpms3d .plant-status.warmup .sdot { background: var(--info); }
.cpms3d .plant-status.warning .sdot { background: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .plant-status.fault .sdot { background: var(--bad); animation: cpms-blink 1s steps(2) infinite; }
.cpms3d .plant-status.fault { color: var(--bad); }
.cpms3d .plant-status-mode { color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 500; }
.cpms3d .plant-info .k, .cpms3d .data-ts .k { color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 500; }
.cpms3d .plant-info.warning .v { color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .alarm-status { cursor: pointer; }
.cpms3d .alarm-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 1px; }
.cpms3d .alarm-status.info .sdot { background: var(--info); }
.cpms3d .alarm-status.warning .sdot { background: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .alarm-status.warning { color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .alarm-status.critical .sdot { background: var(--bad); animation: cpms-blink 1s steps(2) infinite; }
.cpms3d .alarm-status.critical { color: var(--bad); }
.cpms3d .alarm-status.normal .sdot { background: var(--run); }
.cpms3d .ws-status.connected .sdot { background: var(--run); }
.cpms3d .ws-status.connecting .sdot { background: var(--warn); animation: cpms-blink 1s steps(2) infinite; }
.cpms3d .ws-status.offline .sdot { background: var(--bad); }
.cpms3d .ws-status.demo .sdot { background: var(--info); }
.cpms3d .ws-status.demo { color: var(--info); }
.cpms3d .data-ts .v { font-weight: 500; }

.cpms3d .right-top-col { right: 12px; top: 12px; align-items: flex-end; }
.cpms3d .product-logo { background: none; border: 0; backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; padding: 0; }
.cpms3d .product-logo[hidden] { display: none; }
.cpms3d .product-logo img { display: block; height: 72px; width: auto; }
.cpms3d .product-logo.backed { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; }
.cpms3d .outdoor {
  flex: none;
  /* readings share one line when they fit and wrap onto a second when values or fonts are wider */
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 3px 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px 7px;
}
.cpms3d .outdoor .title { flex: 0 0 100%; margin: 0; }
.cpms3d .outdoor.stack { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.cpms3d .outdoor.stack .title { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.cpms3d .outdoor > div:not(.title) { white-space: nowrap; }
.cpms3d .outdoor .k { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 10.5px; margin-right: 3px; }
.cpms3d .outdoor .v { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }
.cpms3d .outdoor .u { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; margin-left: 1px; }
.cpms3d .outdoor.stale .v { color: var(--muted); }

/* side columns: panels stack inside these instead of being positioned one by one */
.cpms3d .side-col { position: absolute; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; pointer-events: none; }
.cpms3d .side-col > * { pointer-events: auto; }
.cpms3d .side-col > .hud { position: relative; }
.cpms3d .left-col { left: 12px; top: 60px; bottom: 12px; width: 300px; }
.cpms3d .left-col > .staging { margin-top: auto; }
.cpms3d .right-col { right: 12px; bottom: 12px; align-items: flex-end; }

.cpms3d .staging { padding: 8px 10px; flex: none; }

/* plant performance summary */
.cpms3d .summary { padding: 8px 10px 6px; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; flex: 0 1 auto; }
.cpms3d .summary[hidden] { display: none; }
.cpms3d .summary .title { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 11px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
.cpms3d .summary .title > span:first-child,
.cpms3d .staging .title > span:first-child,
.cpms3d .outdoor .title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); }
.cpms3d .sum-status { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 1px; }
.cpms3d .sum-status.error { color: var(--bad); }
.cpms3d .sum-block { padding: 7px 0 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cpms3d .sum-block:first-of-type { margin-top: 6px; }
.cpms3d .sum-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--text-2); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.cpms3d .sum-label span { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); }
.cpms3d .sum-big { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.15; }
.cpms3d .sum-pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 2px; }
.cpms3d .sum-pair > div + div { padding-left: 8px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cpms3d .sum-sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; }
.cpms3d .sum-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-top: 2px; }
.cpms3d .eff-rating { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); }
.cpms3d .efficiency.good .sum-big, .cpms3d .efficiency.good .eff-rating { color: var(--run); }
.cpms3d .efficiency.warn .sum-big, .cpms3d .efficiency.warn .eff-rating { color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .efficiency.bad .sum-big, .cpms3d .efficiency.bad .eff-rating { color: var(--bad); }
.cpms3d .sum-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 2px 10px; margin: 3px 0 0; }
.cpms3d .sum-list dt { color: var(--text-2); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.cpms3d .sum-list dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.cpms3d .sum-list dd .u { margin-left: 3px; }

/* branding */
.cpms3d .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px 5px 9px; }
.cpms3d .brand span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
.cpms3d .brand img { height: 28px; width: auto; display: block; }
.cpms3d.theme-dark .brand .logo-light, .cpms3d.theme-light .brand .logo-dark { display: none; }
.cpms3d .staging .title { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 4px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
.cpms3d .staging-row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr auto; gap: 6px;
  padding: 3px 6px; margin: 0 -6px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-2);
}
.cpms3d .staging-row .staging-main { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; }
.cpms3d .staging-row .staging-timer { color: var(--muted); }
.cpms3d .staging-row.active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 18%, transparent); color: var(--text); }
.cpms3d .staging-row.active .staging-timer { color: var(--warn); font-weight: 600; }
.cpms3d .staging-foot { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-2); }
.cpms3d .staging-foot.blocked { color: var(--bad); font-weight: 600; }
.cpms3d .staging.collapsed .staging-body { display: none; }
.cpms3d .collapse-btn { background: none; border: 0; color: var(--text-2); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 0 2px; }
.cpms3d .collapse-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }
.cpms3d .collapse-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 1px; }

.cpms3d .viewbar {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; align-items: stretch;
  padding: 6px;
}
/* class names are prefixed so Grafana's global styles (e.g. Bootstrap's .row gutters) can't leak in */
.cpms3d .viewbar .vb-row { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.cpms3d .viewbar button {
  font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-2); background: var(--chip);
  border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 5px 9px; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.3;
}
.cpms3d .viewbar button:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line-strong); }
.cpms3d .viewbar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--info); outline-offset: 1px; }
.cpms3d .viewbar button[hidden] { display: none; }
.cpms3d .viewbar button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line-strong); background: var(--panel-solid); }
/* tag filter menu */
.cpms3d .tag-menu-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu-btn .caret { font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.7; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu-btn .tag-count:empty { display: none; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu-btn .tag-count { font-weight: 600; color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .tag-menu-btn.filtered { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .tag-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line-strong); background: var(--panel-solid); }
.cpms3d .tag-menu {
  position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); width: 248px; z-index: 20;
  background: var(--panel-solid); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px 8px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
  font-size: 12px; text-align: left;
}
.cpms3d .tag-menu[hidden] { display: none; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 3px 2px; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu label:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--chip); border-radius: 4px; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu input { margin: 0; accent-color: var(--info); cursor: pointer; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu .tm-master { font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu .tm-section { margin: 6px 2px 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu .tm-hint { flex-basis: 100%; padding-left: 21px; margin-top: -2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 400; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu .tm-body.off { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; }
.cpms3d .tag-menu .tm-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; }
.cpms3d .filter-note {
  position: absolute; top: 60px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 4;
  padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--run); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none;
}
.cpms3d .filter-note[hidden] { display: none; }
.cpms3d .legend { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 2px 4px 0; color: var(--text-2); font-size: 11px; }
.cpms3d .legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.cpms3d .legend i { width: 14px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-block; }
.cpms3d .hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; text-align: right; padding: 0 4px; }

.cpms3d .boot {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; z-index: 4;
  color: var(--text-2); font-size: 13px; text-align: center; padding: 24px;
}
.cpms3d .boot.hidden { display: none; }
.cpms3d .boot.error { color: var(--bad); }

/* ───────── equipment tags ───────── */
.cpms3d .tag {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0;
  pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--standby);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px 5px;
  margin: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
  will-change: transform;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
  z-index: 1;
}
.cpms3d .tag:hover, .cpms3d .tag.selected { border-color: var(--line-strong); }
.cpms3d .tag:hover { z-index: 9999 !important; }
.cpms3d .tag.selected { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
.cpms3d .tag.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.cpms3d .tag.on { border-left-color: var(--run); }
.cpms3d .tag.starting, .cpms3d .tag.stopping { border-left-color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .tag.maintenance { border-left-color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .tag.disabled, .cpms3d .tag.unavailable { border-left-color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.85; }
.cpms3d .tag.trip {
  --tag-trip-text: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
  background: #b3261e;
  border-color: #e25b52;
  border-left-color: #ffd2cc;
  color: #fff;
  animation: cpms-trip 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.cpms3d .tag.trip .k, .cpms3d .tag.trip .u, .cpms3d .tag.trip .dur, .cpms3d .tag.trip .h,
.cpms3d .tag.trip .valves, .cpms3d .tag.trip .valve-pill .vstate { color: var(--tag-trip-text); }
.cpms3d .tag.trip .status-line { color: #fff; }
.cpms3d .tag.trip .threshold-good, .cpms3d .tag.trip .threshold-warn,
.cpms3d .tag.trip .threshold-bad, .cpms3d .tag.trip .meter.off { color: #fff; }
.cpms3d .tag.trip .role, .cpms3d .tag.trip .mode-badge { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); color: #fff; }
.cpms3d .tag.trip .rla-bar { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }
.cpms3d .tag.trip .temps { border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); }
.cpms3d .tag.line { border-left-width: 3px; padding: 4px 8px; cursor: default; }
.cpms3d .tag.line.cws { border-left-color: var(--cws); }
.cpms3d .tag.line.cwr { border-left-color: var(--cwr); }
.cpms3d .tag.line.chws { border-left-color: var(--chws); }
.cpms3d .tag.line.chwr { border-left-color: var(--chwr); }
.cpms3d .tag.line.bypass { border-left-color: var(--bypass); cursor: pointer; }
.cpms3d .tag.building { border-left-color: var(--chws); cursor: default; }

.cpms3d .tag-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; }
.cpms3d .vals { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 9px; margin-top: 2px; }
.cpms3d .pairs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 1px 12px; margin-top: 2px; }
.cpms3d .pairs .kv { justify-content: space-between; }
.cpms3d .kv { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; }
.cpms3d .kv .v { font-weight: 600; }
.cpms3d .status-line { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: baseline; margin-top: 1px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); }
.cpms3d .status-line .dur { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.cpms3d .tag.on .status-line { color: var(--run); }
.cpms3d .tag.trip .status-line { color: var(--bad); }
.cpms3d .tag.starting .status-line, .cpms3d .tag.stopping .status-line { color: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .leaders { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.cpms3d .leaders line { stroke: var(--line-strong); stroke-width: 1; }
.cpms3d .leaders circle { fill: var(--text-2); stroke: var(--bg); stroke-width: 1; }
.cpms3d .leaders .sel { stroke: var(--text); }
.cpms3d .leaders circle.sel { fill: var(--text); }
.cpms3d .tag-name { margin-right: 2px; }
.cpms3d .role { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); background: var(--chip); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; }
.cpms3d .mode-badge {
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; min-width: 16px; text-align: center;
  padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--chip); color: var(--muted);
}
.cpms3d .mode-badge.auto { color: var(--run); }
.cpms3d .mode-badge.manual { color: #fff; background: var(--warn); }
.cpms3d .avail:empty { display: none; }
.cpms3d .avail { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; }
/* amber badge, light wrench; a deeper amber keeps the white icon legible on both themes */
.cpms3d .avail.maintenance { background: #b97a12; color: #fff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 3px; align-self: center; }
.cpms3d .tag.trip .avail.maintenance { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); color: #fff; }
.cpms3d .avail.maintenance svg { display: block; }
.cpms3d .avail.disabled, .cpms3d .avail.unavailable { background: var(--muted); color: #fff; }


.cpms3d .tag-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 1px 10px; margin-top: 4px; }
.cpms3d .tag-grid.three { grid-template-columns: auto auto auto; }
.cpms3d .k { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 11px; }
.cpms3d .v { font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }
.cpms3d .u { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; margin-left: 2px; }
.cpms3d .cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; }
.cpms3d .cell .k { font-size: 10px; }
.cpms3d .temps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto auto; gap: 1px 10px; margin-top: 5px; padding-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cpms3d .temps .h { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; text-align: right; }
.cpms3d .fans { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto auto; gap: 2px 8px; margin-top: 4px; align-items: center; }
.cpms3d .fan-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--standby); display: inline-block; margin-right: 5px; }
.cpms3d .fan.on .fan-dot { background: var(--run); box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--run); }
.cpms3d .fan.trip .fan-dot { background: var(--bad); }
.cpms3d .valves { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2); }
.cpms3d .valve-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.cpms3d .valve-pill .vstate { font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.cpms3d .valve-pill.on .vstate { color: var(--run); }

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const root = document.getElementById('cpms3d');
  if (!root || root.dataset.ready === '1') return;
  root.dataset.ready = '1';

  /* ═════════════ small DOM helpers (scoped to this panel) ═════════════ */
  const q = (id) => root.querySelector('#' + id);
  const setText = (id, text) => {
    const el = q(id);
    if (el && el.textContent !== text) el.textContent = text;
  };
  const toggleCls = (el, cls, on) => { if (el) el.classList.toggle(cls, !!on); };

  /* ═════════════ theme ═════════════ */
  const inGrafana = typeof window.grafanaBootData !== 'undefined';
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  let theme = (inGrafana && window.grafanaBootData && window.grafanaBootData.user && window.grafanaBootData.user.theme) || 'dark';
  if (params.get('theme') === 'light' || params.get('theme') === 'dark') theme = params.get('theme');
  if (theme !== 'light' && theme !== 'dark') theme = 'dark';
  root.classList.remove('theme-dark', 'theme-light');
  root.classList.add('theme-' + theme);
  root.classList.add('compact');

  /* ═════════════ product logo (loaded by URL, not embedded) ═════════════
     Put nextgen-cpms-logo.png and nextgen-cpms-logo-dark.png in Grafana's public/img folder, or set
     window.CPMS_PRODUCT_LOGO_URL / window.CPMS_PRODUCT_LOGO_DARK_URL to wherever they are hosted.
     Relative paths resolve from the Grafana root, including sub-path installs (appSubUrl). */
  const PRODUCT_LOGO_URL = window.CPMS_PRODUCT_LOGO_URL || '/custom/nextgen-cpms-logo.png';
  const PRODUCT_LOGO_DARK_URL = window.CPMS_PRODUCT_LOGO_DARK_URL || '/custom/nextgen-cpms-logo-dark.png';
  function resolveAssetUrl(url) {
    if (/^([a-z]+:|\/)/i.test(url)) return url;
    const subPath = String((window.grafanaBootData && window.grafanaBootData.settings && window.grafanaBootData.settings.appSubUrl) || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    return subPath + '/' + url;
  }
  (function loadProductLogo() {
    const box = q('product-logo');
    const img = q('product-logo-img');
    if (!box || !img) return;
    // dark theme tries the light-text version first, then the original on a light backing
    const candidates = theme === 'dark' ? [PRODUCT_LOGO_DARK_URL, PRODUCT_LOGO_URL] : [PRODUCT_LOGO_URL];
    let index = 0;
    img.onload = () => {
      box.classList.toggle('backed', theme === 'dark' && candidates[index] === PRODUCT_LOGO_URL && candidates.length > 1);
      box.hidden = false;
    };
    img.onerror = () => {
      index += 1;
      if (index < candidates.length) { img.src = resolveAssetUrl(candidates[index]); return; }
      box.hidden = true;
      console.warn('CPMS 3D: product logo not found at ' + candidates.map(resolveAssetUrl).join(' or '));
    };
    img.src = resolveAssetUrl(candidates[0]);
  })();

  /* ═════════════ tag filter (read by the tag layout every frame, set by the Tags menu) ═════════════ */
  const TAG_TYPES = ['chillers', 'cwp', 'chwp', 'towers', 'lines'];
  const tagFilter = { show: true, types: { chillers: true, cwp: true, chwp: true, towers: true, lines: true }, mode: 'all' };
  function tagTypeOf(id) {
    if (id.startsWith('chiller-')) return 'chillers';
    if (id.startsWith('pump-cwp-')) return 'cwp';
    if (id.startsWith('pump-chwp-')) return 'chwp';
    if (id.startsWith('tower-')) return 'towers';
    return 'lines';
  }
  // something an operator should look at: a trip, a start/stop in progress, a device out of service,
  // or any reading on the tag in its warning or bad range
  function tagNeedsAttention(el) {
    const c = el.classList;
    return c.contains('trip') || c.contains('starting') || c.contains('stopping') ||
      c.contains('maintenance') || c.contains('disabled') || c.contains('unavailable') ||
      !!el.querySelector('.threshold-warn, .threshold-bad');
  }
  // trips and the selected equipment are never filtered out
  function tagAllowed(el, type, isSelected) {
    if (el.classList.contains('trip') || isSelected) return true;
    if (!tagFilter.show || !tagFilter.types[type]) return false;
    if (tagFilter.mode === 'running') {
      return type === 'lines' || el.classList.contains('on') || el.classList.contains('starting') || el.classList.contains('stopping');
    }
    if (tagFilter.mode === 'exceptions') return tagNeedsAttention(el);
    return true;
  }
  function tagFilterIsDefault() {
    return tagFilter.show && tagFilter.mode === 'all' && TAG_TYPES.every((t) => tagFilter.types[t]);
  }

  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ═════════════ pump → chiller assignment (refreshed from payload) ═════════════ */
  const cwpMap = { cwp1: ['chiller1'], cwp2: ['chiller2'], cwp3: ['chiller3'] };
  const chwpMap = { chwp1: ['chiller1'], chwp2: ['chiller2'], chwp3: ['chiller3'] };

  /* ═════════════ shared rules ═════════════
     Status, threshold and efficiency rules live in /custom/cpms-core.js so the 2D and 3D views always
     agree. These pass-throughs are only called once the core has loaded. */
  const rules = () => window.CPMS.rules;
  const isGoodTelemetry = (item) => rules().isGoodTelemetry(item);
  const isRunningState = (item) => rules().isRunningState(item);
  const isTripState = (device) => rules().isTripState(device);
  const shortMode = (mode) => rules().shortMode(mode);
  const numericReading = (value) => rules().numericReading(value);
  const chillerThreshold = (metric, value, chiller) => rules().chillerThreshold(metric, value, chiller);
  const headerThreshold = (metric, value, header, setpoint) => rules().headerThreshold(metric, value, header, setpoint);
  const calcWetBulb = (t, rh) => rules().calcWetBulb(t, rh);

  /* ═════════════ shared core loader ═════════════ */
  const CORE_VERSION = 1;
  function loadCore() {
    if (window.CPMS && window.CPMS.version >= CORE_VERSION) return Promise.resolve(window.CPMS);
    if (window.__cpmsCorePromise) return window.__cpmsCorePromise;
    const url = (window.CPMS_CORE_URL || '/custom/cpms-core.js') + '?v=' + CORE_VERSION;
    window.__cpmsCorePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = url;
      s.async = true;
      s.onload = () => (window.CPMS && window.CPMS.version >= CORE_VERSION ? resolve(window.CPMS) : reject(new Error('cpms-core.js loaded but is out of date')));
      s.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Could not load ' + url));
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    }).catch((err) => { window.__cpmsCorePromise = null; throw err; });
    return window.__cpmsCorePromise;
  }
  function updateModeBadge(id, mode) {
    const el = q(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = shortMode(mode);
    el.title = mode === 'AUTO' ? 'AUTO' : mode === 'MANUAL' ? 'MANUAL' : 'Control mode unavailable';
    el.classList.toggle('auto', mode === 'AUTO');
    el.classList.toggle('manual', mode === 'MANUAL');
    el.classList.toggle('unknown', mode !== 'AUTO' && mode !== 'MANUAL');
  }
  function updateAvailabilityIcon(id, availability, status) {
    const el = q(id);
    if (!el) return;
    const value = status === 'UNAVAILABLE' ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : (availability || 'AVAILABLE');
    el.className = 'avail ' + value.toLowerCase();
    if (el.dataset.value === value) return;   // unchanged: skip rebuilding the badge
    el.dataset.value = value;
    if (value === 'MAINTENANCE') {
      el.innerHTML = WRENCH_ICON;
      el.title = 'Maintenance';
      el.setAttribute('role', 'img');
      el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Maintenance');
      return;
    }
    el.removeAttribute('role');
    el.removeAttribute('aria-label');
    el.title = value;
    el.textContent = value === 'DISABLED' ? 'Disabled' : value === 'UNAVAILABLE' ? 'Unavail' : '';
  }
  const WRENCH_ICON = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">' +
    '<path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/></svg>';

  function toPanelPump(pump, flowRate) {
    if (!pump) return undefined;
    const effectiveRun = isRunningState(pump);
    return {
      deviceId: pump.deviceId,
      effectiveRun,
      requestedOn: effectiveRun || pump.commanded === 'START',
      effectiveSpeedCmd: pump.speedFb ?? pump.speedCmd ?? 0,
      flowRate: flowRate ?? pump.flowRate,
      pressure: pump.pressure,
      controlMode: pump.mode,
      availability: pump.availability,
      trip: isTripState(pump),
      reason: pump.reason,
      status: pump.state,
    };
  }
  function toPanelFan(fan, coolingLoad) {
    if (!fan) return undefined;
    const effectiveRun = isRunningState(fan);
    return {
      deviceId: fan.deviceId,
      effectiveRun,
      requestedOn: effectiveRun || fan.commanded === 'START',
      effectiveSpeedCmd: fan.speedFb ?? fan.speedCmd ?? 0,
      controlMode: fan.mode,
      availability: fan.availability,
      coolingLoad,
      trip: isTripState(fan),
      reason: fan.reason,
      status: fan.state,
    };
  }
  function toPanelValve(valve) {
    if (!valve) return undefined;
    const opened = isRunningState(valve);
    return {
      deviceId: valve.deviceId,
      opened,
      requestedOpen: opened || valve.commanded === 'OPEN',
      closed: !opened,
      controlMode: valve.mode,
      availability: valve.availability,
      status: opened ? 'OPEN' : 'CLOSED',
    };
  }
  function toPanelChiller(pkg, plantCoolingLoad, priorityRole) {
    if (!pkg) return undefined;
    const ch = pkg.chiller || {};
    const physicalState = ch.state ?? 'UNAVAILABLE';
    const effectiveRun = isGoodTelemetry(pkg.chiller) && physicalState === 'RUNNING';
    return {
      deviceId: pkg.chillerId,
      effectiveRun,
      physicalState,
      requestedOn: effectiveRun || pkg.state === 'STARTING' || ch.commanded === 'START',
      priorityRole: priorityRole || '',
      packageMode: pkg.controlMode,
      controlMode: ch.mode,
      availability: pkg.availability,
      packageStatus: pkg.state,
      stateChangedAt: pkg.stateChangedAt,
      packageReason: pkg.reason,
      telemetryGood: isGoodTelemetry(pkg) && isGoodTelemetry(pkg.chiller),
      coolingLoad: effectiveRun ? plantCoolingLoad : 0,
      estimatedLoadRt: pkg.estimatedLoadRt,
      rlaPercent: pkg.rlaPercent ?? 0,
      setPoint: ch.setpoint ?? ch.setPoint ?? ch.activeSetpoint ?? 0,
      evapEWT: ch.evapEWT,
      evapLWT: ch.evapLWT,
      condEWT: ch.condEWT,
      condLWT: ch.condLWT,
      efficiencyKwPerRt: pkg.efficiencyKwPerRt,
      power: ch.power ?? 0,
      trip: isTripState(pkg.chiller),
      reason: ch.reason,
      status: ch.state ?? pkg.state,
    };
  }

  /* ═════════════ HUD updates ═════════════ */
  function updatePlantStatus(plant) {
    if (!plant) return;
    let status = plant.state || 'UNKNOWN';
    let className = 'normal';
    const mode = plant.controlMode === 'MANUAL' ? 'MANUAL' : (plant.plantMode || '');
    if (plant.emergency) { status = 'EMERGENCY'; className = 'fault'; }
    else if (plant.lockout) { status = 'LOCKOUT'; className = 'fault'; }
    else if (plant.health === 'FAULT' || plant.state === 'FAULT') { status = 'FAULT'; className = 'fault'; }
    else if (plant.health === 'DEGRADED' || plant.state === 'UNAVAILABLE') {
      status = plant.health === 'DEGRADED' ? 'DEGRADED' : 'UNAVAILABLE';
      className = 'warning';
    }
    else if (plant.controlMode === 'MANUAL') { className = 'warning'; }
    else if (mode === 'WARMUP') { status = 'WARMUP'; className = 'warmup'; }

    const el = q('plant-status');
    el.classList.remove('normal', 'warmup', 'warning', 'fault');
    el.classList.add(className);
    setText('plant-status-text', status);
    setText('plant-status-mode', mode && mode !== status ? mode : '');
  }

  function updatePlantDemand(plant) {
    const chillers = Object.values((plant && plant.chillers) || {});
    const towers = Object.values((plant && plant.coolingTowers) || {});
    const runningChillers = chillers.filter((pkg) => pkg.availability === 'AVAILABLE' && (isRunningState(pkg && pkg.chiller) || isRunningState(pkg))).length;
    const runningTowers = towers.filter((tower) => tower.availability === 'AVAILABLE' && isRunningState(tower)).length;
    const requiredChillers = Number(plant?.requiredChillers ?? plant?.requestedChillerCount ?? runningChillers);

    toggleCls(q('plant-info'), 'warning', runningChillers !== requiredChillers || runningTowers !== requiredTowers);
  }

  function formatChillerStateDuration(state, changedAt) {
    if (state !== 'RUNNING' && state !== 'OFF') return '--';
    const changedAtMs = Number(changedAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(changedAtMs) || changedAtMs <= 0) return '--';
    const elapsedMs = Date.now() - changedAtMs;
    if (elapsedMs < 0) return '--';
    const totalMinutes = Math.floor(elapsedMs / 60000);
    const days = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 1440);
    const hours = Math.floor((totalMinutes % 1440) / 60);
    const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
    return days > 0 ? days + 'd ' + hours + 'h'
      : hours > 0 ? hours + 'h ' + minutes + 'm'
        : totalMinutes > 0 ? totalMinutes + 'm' : '<1m';
  }

  function formatDataTimestamp(timestamp) {
    const date = new Date(Number(timestamp));
    if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return '--/-- --:--:--';
    const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return p(date.getDate()) + '/' + p(date.getMonth() + 1) + ' ' + p(date.getHours()) + ':' + p(date.getMinutes()) + ':' + p(date.getSeconds());
  }
  function updateDataTimestamp(plant) {
    const date = new Date(Number(plant && plant.timestamp));
    setText('data-ts-value', formatDataTimestamp(plant && plant.timestamp));
    q('data-ts').title = Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) ? date.toLocaleString() : 'Telemetry data timestamp unavailable';
  }

  function formatStagingNumber(value, decimals) {
    const number = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(number) ? number.toFixed(decimals) : '--';
  }
  function formatStagingDuration(ms) {
    const number = Number(ms);
    if (!Number.isFinite(number) || number <= 0) return '0s';
    const seconds = Math.floor(number / 1000);
    const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const rest = seconds % 60;
    return minutes > 0 ? minutes + 'm ' + String(rest).padStart(2, '0') + 's' : rest + 's';
  }
  function updateStagingTrigger(rowId, trigger, decimals, unit, operator) {
    const value = formatStagingNumber(trigger?.value, decimals);
    const limit = formatStagingNumber(trigger?.limit, decimals);
    const hasValue = value !== '--' && limit !== '--';
    const timer = trigger?.delayMs ? formatStagingDuration(trigger?.elapsedMs || 0) + ' / ' + formatStagingDuration(trigger.delayMs) : '-';
    toggleCls(q(rowId), 'active', !!trigger?.active);
    setText(rowId + '-value', hasValue ? value + ' ' + operator + ' ' + limit + unit : '--');

  function updateStagingInfo(plant) {

    updateStagingTrigger('staging-sd-load', chiller?.stageDown?.load, 0, ' RT', '<');

  function formatValue(value, decimals) {

  function updateOutdoorWeather(plant) {

  /* ═════════════ payload → device list (same shape as the 2D panel) ═════════════ */
  function toDashboardPayload(payload) {
    if (payload?.devices) return payload;
    const plant = payload?.type === 'plant-state' ? payload.data : payload;
    if (!plant) return null;

    updatePlantStatus(plant);
    updatePlantDemand(plant);
    updateDataTimestamp(plant);
    updateOutdoorWeather(plant);
    updateStagingInfo(plant);
    updateAlarmStatus(payload?.alarms?.summary);
    updatePumpMaps(plant);

    const devices = [];
    const plantCoolingLoad = Number(plant.chwHeader?.coolingLoad || 0);
    const chillers = plant.chillers || {};
    const cwpFlowRateByPump = {};
    const chwpFlowRateByPump = {};

    Object.values(chillers).forEach((pkg) => {
      if (pkg?.cwPump?.deviceId) cwpFlowRateByPump[pkg.cwPump.deviceId] = pkg.cwPump.flowRate;
      if (pkg?.chwPump?.deviceId) chwpFlowRateByPump[pkg.chwPump.deviceId] = pkg.chwPump.flowRate;
      const chiller = toPanelChiller(pkg, Number(pkg?.chwPump?.energyFlowRate || 0) * 78.986, plant.chillerPriority?.[pkg.chillerId]);
      if (chiller) devices.push(chiller);
    });
    Object.values(plant.cwPumps || {}).forEach((cwp) => {
      const d = toPanelPump(cwp, cwpFlowRateByPump[cwp.deviceId]);
      if (d) devices.push(d);
    });
    Object.values(plant.chwPumps || {}).forEach((chwp) => {
      const d = toPanelPump(chwp, chwpFlowRateByPump[chwp.deviceId]);
      if (d) devices.push(d);
    });

    const towers = Object.values(plant.coolingTowers || {});
    const runningFanCount = towers.flatMap((t) => t?.fans || []).filter((f) => isRunningState(f)).length || 1;
    const fanCoolingLoad = plantCoolingLoad / runningFanCount;
    towers.forEach((tower) => {
      devices.push({
        deviceId: tower.towerId,
        priorityRole: plant.coolingTowerPriority?.[tower.towerId] || '',
        controlMode: tower.controlMode,
        availability: tower.availability,
        reason: tower.reason,
        status: tower.state,
      });
      (tower.fans || []).forEach((fan) => { const d = toPanelFan(fan, fanCoolingLoad); if (d) devices.push(d); });
      (tower.valves || []).forEach((valve) => { const d = toPanelValve(valve); if (d) devices.push(d); });
    });

    if (plant.bypassValve) {
      const mv = Number(plant.bypassValve.mv ?? 0);
      const isOpen = mv > 0;
      devices.push({
        deviceId: 'bypassValve1', opened: isOpen, requestedOpen: isOpen, closed: !isOpen,
        status: isOpen ? 'MODULATING' : 'CLOSED',
        sv: plant.bypassValve.sv ?? 0, pv: plant.bypassValve.pv ?? 0, mv, pressureUnit: 'bar',
      });
    }
    if (plant.chwHeader) {
      const h = plant.chwHeader;
      devices.push({ deviceId: 'chwpHeader', chws: h.chws, chwr: h.chwr, flowRate: h.flowRate, pressure: h.pressure, supplyPressure: h.supplyPressure, returnPressure: h.returnPressure, coolingLoad: h.coolingLoad });
    }
    if (plant.cwHeader) {
      const h = plant.cwHeader;
      devices.push({ deviceId: 'cwpHeader', cws: h.cws, cwr: h.cwr, flowRate: h.flowRate, pressure: h.pressure, supplyPressure: h.supplyPressure, returnPressure: h.returnPressure });
    }
    return { devices };
  }

  /* ═════════════ three.js loader ═════════════ */
  function loadThree() {
    if (window.THREE && window.THREE.WebGLRenderer) return Promise.resolve(window.THREE);
    if (window.__cpmsThreePromise) return window.__cpmsThreePromise;
    const url = window.CPMS_THREE_URL || 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js';
    // If the host page has an AMD/UMD loader, the script tag can register THREE as a module instead
    // of a global. The fallback re-evaluates the bundle with define/module/exports hidden.
    const viaFetch = () => fetch(url)
      .then((r) => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.text(); })
      .then((code) => {
        (new Function('define', 'module', 'exports', code)).call(window);
        if (!window.THREE) throw new Error('three.js did not register a global');
        return window.THREE;
      });
    window.__cpmsThreePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = url;
      s.async = true;
      s.onload = () => (window.THREE ? resolve(window.THREE) : viaFetch().then(resolve, reject));
      s.onerror = () => viaFetch().then(resolve, () => reject(new Error('Could not load three.js from ' + url)));
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    }).catch((err) => { window.__cpmsThreePromise = null; throw err; });
    return window.__cpmsThreePromise;
  }

  /* ═════════════ plant layout (metres; x = across plant, z = toward building side, y = up) ═════════════ */
  const COL = [-10, 0, 10];          // chiller / pump columns
  const TOWER_X = [-12, 0, 12];      // cooling tower centres
  const TOWER_Z = -20, DECK_Y = 5;
  const CWP_Z = -9.5, CHWP_Z = 9.5;
  const BYPASS_X = 17, BLDG_TAP_X = 20, BLDG_X = 27, BLDG_Z = 9.5;

  function createScene(THREE) {
    const V3 = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
    const stage = q('cpms3d-stage');
    const tagLayer = q('cpms3d-tags');
    const dark = theme === 'dark';
    const cssColor = (name, fallback) => {
      const v = getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
      try { return new THREE.Color(v || fallback); } catch (_) { return new THREE.Color(fallback); }
    };
    const COLORS = {
      cws: cssColor('--cws', '#2fbcc1'),
      cwr: cssColor('--cwr', '#f08b45'),
      chws: cssColor('--chws', '#4a95e6'),
      chwr: cssColor('--chwr', '#e9506a'),
      bypass: cssColor('--bypass', '#9a5ce6'),
      run: new THREE.Color('#3fbf7f'),
      warn: new THREE.Color('#e3a43a'),
      bad: new THREE.Color('#ef4b4b'),
      standby: new THREE.Color(dark ? '#59626d' : '#8a949e'),
      dim: new THREE.Color(dark ? '#30363e' : '#9aa3ac'),
    };
    const BG = dark ? 0x0e1217 : 0xe9edf1;

    /* ── renderer ── */
    let renderer;
    try {
      renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error('WebGL is not available in this browser, so the 3D view cannot start.');
    }
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
    renderer.setClearColor(BG);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    stage.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(BG, 110, 220);
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(36, 1, 0.5, 500);

    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(dark ? 0xc6d6ff : 0xffffff, dark ? 0x161b22 : 0x8a929b, dark ? 0.62 : 0.78));
    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, dark ? 0.78 : 0.82);
    sun.position.set(28, 55, 30);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    Object.assign(sun.shadow.camera, { left: -48, right: 48, top: 48, bottom: -48, near: 10, far: 140 });
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.0006;
    scene.add(sun);
    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(dark ? 0x7fa6d9 : 0xffffff, dark ? 0.22 : 0.25);
    fill.position.set(-30, 20, -25);
    scene.add(fill);

    /* ── material + mesh helpers ── */
    const disposables = [];
    const std = (color, roughness = 0.62, metalness = 0.18, extra) => {
      const m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(Object.assign({ color, roughness, metalness }, extra || {}));
      disposables.push(m);
      return m;
    };
    const add = (parent, geom, mat, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, opts) => {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
      m.position.set(x, y, z);
      m.castShadow = !(opts && opts.noShadow);
      m.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(m);
      disposables.push(geom);
      return m;
    };
    const box = (parent, w, h, d, mat, x, y, z, opts) => add(parent, new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), mat, x, y, z, opts);
    const cyl = (parent, r, len, axis, mat, x, y, z, opts) => {
      const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, (opts && opts.r2) || r, len, (opts && opts.seg) || 28, 1, !!(opts && opts.open));
      if (axis === 'x') g.rotateZ(Math.PI / 2);
      if (axis === 'z') g.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
      return add(parent, g, mat, x, y, z, opts);
    };
    const canvasTexture = (w, h, draw) => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = w; c.height = h;
      draw(c.getContext('2d'), w, h);
      const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
      t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      t.anisotropy = 4;
      disposables.push(t);
      return t;
    };

    const M = {
      concrete: std(dark ? 0x3a4149 : 0xb9c0c7, 0.95, 0),
      steel: std(dark ? 0x2c333b : 0x5b6570, 0.55, 0.45),
      steelLight: std(dark ? 0x58636f : 0x8f9aa5, 0.5, 0.4),
      motor: std(dark ? 0x3b4a5a : 0x4f6378, 0.45, 0.35),
      panel: std(dark ? 0xb9c2ca : 0xdce2e7, 0.6, 0.05),
      blade: std(0x2a3036, 0.5, 0.3),
      bladeTip: std(0xd9dde1, 0.5, 0.2),
      deck: std(dark ? 0x2a3139 : 0x9aa4ad, 0.8, 0.3),
      gauge: std(0x15191e, 0.8, 0),
    };

    /* ── ground ── */
    const groundMat = std(dark ? 0x10151b : 0xd9dfe4, 1, 0);
    const ground = add(scene, new THREE.PlaneGeometry(600, 600), groundMat, 0, -0.22, 0, { noShadow: true });
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    box(scene, 62, 0.22, 50, std(dark ? 0x1a2028 : 0xc9d0d6, 0.95, 0), 5, -0.11, -4.5, { noShadow: true });
    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(62, 31, dark ? 0x2a323c : 0xb3bcc5, dark ? 0x202730 : 0xbfc7cf);
    grid.position.set(5, 0.005, -4.5);
    grid.material.transparent = true;
    grid.material.opacity = dark ? 0.55 : 0.6;
    scene.add(grid);

    /* ── pickable equipment registry ── */
    const equip = {};
    const pickables = [];
    function registerEquip(key, rec) {
      rec.key = key;
      rec.state = rec.state || 'standby';
      rec.tintMats = rec.tintMats || [];
      rec.spinners = rec.spinners || [];
      rec.group && rec.group.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh) { o.userData.pickKey = rec.pickKey || key; pickables.push(o); } });
      equip[key] = rec;
      return rec;
    }
    // Give every mesh in an equipment group its own material copy (shared materials would tint every
    // machine at once), so a trip can light up the whole machine. Beacons, gauges and pads are left alone.
    function ownMaterials(group, keep) {
      const copies = new Map();
      group.traverse((o) => {
        if (!o.isMesh || keep.includes(o.material) || o.material === M.concrete) return;
        let m = copies.get(o.material);
        if (!m) { m = o.material.clone(); disposables.push(m); copies.set(o.material, m); }
        o.material = m;
      });
      return Array.from(copies.values());
    }
    function beaconMat() { return std(0x59626d, 0.35, 0.1, { emissive: 0x000000 }); }

    /* ── chillers ── */
    function buildChiller(i, x) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      g.position.set(x, 0, 0);
      scene.add(g);
      const shell = std(dark ? 0x667b8f : 0x7890a6, 0.48, 0.3);
      const shell2 = std(dark ? 0x5a6d80 : 0x6a8197, 0.48, 0.3);
      box(g, 3.4, 0.14, 8.2, M.concrete, 0, 0.07, 0);
      box(g, 2.6, 0.2, 7.4, M.steel, 0, 0.24, 0);
      [-2.4, 0, 2.4].forEach((z) => box(g, 1.5, 0.5, 0.3, M.steel, 0, 0.58, z));
      cyl(g, 0.7, 6.4, 'z', shell, 0, 1.05, 0);
      cyl(g, 0.62, 6.4, 'z', shell, 0, 2.45, 0);
      [-1, 1].forEach((s) => {
        cyl(g, 0.78, 0.3, 'z', shell2, 0, 1.05, s * 3.3);
        cyl(g, 0.7, 0.3, 'z', shell2, 0, 2.45, s * 3.3);
        box(g, 0.35, 0.9, 0.35, M.steel, 0, 1.75, s * 2.6);
      });
      const comp = cyl(g, 0.5, 1.7, 'z', shell2, 0, 3.55, -1.3);
      cyl(g, 0.46, 2.0, 'z', M.motor, 0, 3.55, 0.6);
      cyl(g, 0.3, 0.2, 'z', M.steelLight, 0, 3.55, 1.7);
      cyl(g, 0.22, 2.3, 'y', shell2, -0.85, 2.35, -2.1);
      cyl(g, 0.22, 0.85, 'x', shell2, -0.45, 3.55, -2.1);
      cyl(g, 0.17, 0.6, 'y', shell2, 0.25, 3.05, -2.0);
      box(g, 0.3, 1.7, 1.2, M.panel, 1.45, 1.35, 2.3);
      box(g, 0.03, 1.22, 0.2, M.gauge, 1.615, 1.35, 2.3, { noShadow: true });
      const rlaGeom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.035, 1, 0.13);
      rlaGeom.translate(0, 0.5, 0);
      const rlaMat = std(0x3fbf7f, 0.5, 0, { emissive: 0x000000 });
      const rlaFill = add(g, rlaGeom, rlaMat, 1.62, 0.76, 2.3, { noShadow: true });
      rlaFill.scale.y = 0.001;
      const beacon = beaconMat();
      cyl(g, 0.05, 0.35, 'y', M.steel, 1.45, 2.35, 2.3);
      add(g, new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15, 18, 12), beacon, 1.45, 2.6, 2.3);
      return registerEquip('chiller' + i, {
        type: 'chiller', label: 'Chiller ' + i, group: g, beacon, tintMats: ownMaterials(g, [beacon, rlaMat, M.gauge]), rlaFill, rlaMat,
        anchor: V3(x, 4.5, 0.4), focus: V3(x, 2.2, 0), focusR: 25, comp,
      });
    }

    /* ── pumps (end-suction; dz = direction the suction faces) ── */
    function buildPump(key, label, x, z, dz, circuitColor) {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      g.position.set(x, 0, z);
      scene.add(g);
      const casing = std(circuitColor.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(dark ? 0x3a434d : 0x6c7782), 0.45), 0.45, 0.35);
      box(g, 1.5, 0.14, 3.4, M.concrete, 0, 0.07, -dz * 0.9);
      box(g, 1.1, 0.2, 3.0, M.steel, 0, 0.24, -dz * 0.9);
      cyl(g, 0.56, 0.46, 'z', casing, 0, 0.8, 0);
      cyl(g, 0.22, 0.6, 'z', casing, 0, 0.78, dz * 0.48);
      cyl(g, 0.3, 0.06, 'z', M.steelLight, 0, 0.78, dz * 0.78);
      cyl(g, 0.2, 0.42, 'y', casing, 0, 1.3, 0);
      cyl(g, 0.28, 0.06, 'y', M.steelLight, 0, 1.5, 0);
      box(g, 0.5, 0.45, 0.4, casing, 0, 0.55, 0);
      cyl(g, 0.2, 0.55, 'z', M.steelLight, 0, 0.78, -dz * 0.5);
      // spinning coupling (visible indicator that the shaft turns)
      const coupling = new THREE.Group();

      cyl(g, 0.42, 1.15, 'z', M.motor, 0, 0.8, -dz * 1.65);
      box(g, 0.75, 0.35, 0.9, M.motor, 0, 0.45, -dz * 1.65);

    /* ── cooling towers (two fan cells each) ── */
    const louverTex = canvasTexture(64, 64, (ctx, w, h) => {

    function buildTower(i, x) {

      [-2.25, 2.25].forEach((sx, k) => {

        const ring = beaconMat();

    /* ── valves ── */
    function buildValve(key, pos, axis, size) {
      const s = size || 1;

      scene.add(g);
      const body = std(dark ? 0x4a5560 : 0x6a7682, 0.5, 0.4);

      cyl(g, 0.42 * s, 0.06 * s, axis, M.steelLight, ...offsetAlong(axis, -0.14 * s));

      const stemPos = up === 'y' ? [0, 0.45 * s, 0] : [0.45 * s, 0, 0];

    }
    function offsetAlong(axis, d) { return axis === 'x' ? [d, 0, 0] : axis === 'y' ? [0, d, 0] : [0, 0, d]; }

    /* ── building ── */
    function buildBuilding() {
      const g = new THREE.Group();
      g.position.set(BLDG_X, 0, BLDG_Z);
      scene.add(g);
      const winTex = canvasTexture(128, 256, (ctx, w, h) => {
        ctx.fillStyle = dark ? '#26313d' : '#9fb0bf';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

            ctx.fillRect(xx, yy, 12, 13);
          }

        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      });
      winTex.repeat.set(1.5, 0.75);
      const wall = std(0xffffff, 0.75, 0.05, { map: winTex });
      box(g, 6, 9, 10, wall, 0, 4.5, 0);
      box(g, 6.3, 0.4, 10.3, M.deck, 0, 9.2, 0);
      box(g, 2.2, 1.0, 2.2, M.steelLight, 1, 9.9, -2.5);

    /* ── tower deck + structure ── */
    box(scene, 36, 0.3, 7.6, M.deck, 0, DECK_Y - 0.15, TOWER_Z);
    [-17.6, -6, 6, 17.6].forEach((x) => [TOWER_Z - 3.6, TOWER_Z + 3.6].forEach((z) => box(scene, 0.35, DECK_Y - 0.3, 0.35, M.steel, x, (DECK_Y - 0.3) / 2, z)));
    box(scene, 36, 0.12, 0.12, M.steelLight, 0, DECK_Y + 1.0, TOWER_Z + 3.75, { noShadow: true });

    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      buildChiller(i, COL[i - 1]);
      buildPump('cwp' + i, 'CWP ' + i, COL[i - 1], CWP_Z, -1, COLORS.cws);
      buildPump('chwp' + i, 'CHWP ' + i, COL[i - 1], CHWP_Z, 1, COLORS.chwr);
      buildTower(i, TOWER_X[i - 1]);
    }
    buildBuilding();

    /* ═════════════ piping ═════════════ */
    const flowTime = { value: 0 };
    /* Flow animation look. Tune here: lower glow / speed = calmer, higher = more noticeable.
       speed: m/s the bands travel; spacing: m between bands; glow: band brightness (0-1);
       mute: how much running pipes are desaturated toward grey (0 = full circuit colour). */
    const FLOW_STYLE = { speed: 0.9, spacing: 2.6, glow: 0.7, mute: 0.3 };
    const flowStyle = {
      speed: { value: FLOW_STYLE.speed }, spacing: { value: FLOW_STYLE.spacing },
      glow: { value: FLOW_STYLE.glow }, mute: { value: FLOW_STYLE.mute },
      onLevel: { value: dark ? 0.66 : 0.8 },
    };
    const pipeVS = `
      varying vec3 vN; varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vWP;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        vN = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * normal);
        vec4 wp = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        vWP = wp.xyz;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp;
      }`;
    const pipeFS = `
      uniform vec3 uColor; uniform vec3 uOff; uniform float uOn; uniform float uDir; uniform float uLen; uniform float uTime; uniform float uSpeed; uniform float uSpacing; uniform float uGlow; uniform float uMute; uniform float uOnLevel; uniform vec3 uFog; uniform float uFogNear; uniform float uFogFar;
      varying vec3 vN; varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vWP;
      void main() {
        vec3 n = normalize(vN);
        vec3 L = normalize(vec3(0.45, 0.85, 0.4));
        vec3 V = normalize(cameraPosition - vWP);
        float diff = 0.48 + 0.52 * max(dot(n, L), 0.0);
        float spec = pow(max(dot(reflect(-L, n), V), 0.0), 24.0) * 0.25;
        // running pipes: circuit colour, slightly muted
        vec3 muted = mix(uColor, vec3(dot(uColor, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114))), uMute);
        vec3 base = mix(uOff, muted * uOnLevel, uOn);
        // soft travelling band: gentle rise, longer fall, so direction still reads without hard edges
        float d = vUv.x * uLen;
        float s = fract((d - uDir * uTime * uSpeed) / uSpacing);
        float band = smoothstep(0.0, 0.32, s) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.32, 0.72, s));
        vec3 col = base * diff + spec * 0.6;
        col += muted * band * uOn * uGlow;
        float fogF = smoothstep(uFogNear, uFogFar, length(cameraPosition - vWP));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(col, uFog, fogF), 1.0);
      }`;
    const offBase = new THREE.Color(dark ? 0x2b323a : 0xbcc4cc);
    const fogColor = new THREE.Color(BG);
    const runs = {};

    function roundedPath(pts, radius) {
      const path = new THREE.CurvePath();
      let prev = pts[0].clone();
      for (let k = 1; k < pts.length - 1; k++) {
        const a = pts[k - 1], b = pts[k], c = pts[k + 1];
        const d1 = b.clone().sub(a), d2 = c.clone().sub(b);
        const r = Math.min(radius, d1.length() / 2, d2.length() / 2);
        const p1 = b.clone().sub(d1.normalize().multiplyScalar(r));
        const p2 = b.clone().add(d2.normalize().multiplyScalar(r));
        if (prev.distanceTo(p1) > 1e-4) path.add(new THREE.LineCurve3(prev, p1));
        path.add(new THREE.QuadraticBezierCurve3(p1, b.clone(), p2));
        prev = p2;
      }
      path.add(new THREE.LineCurve3(prev, pts[pts.length - 1].clone()));
      return path;
    }

    function addRun(id, circuit, points, radius) {
      const r = radius || 0.24;
      const pts = points.map((p) => V3(p[0], p[1], p[2]));
      const path = roundedPath(pts, Math.max(0.45, r * 2));
      const len = path.getLength();
      const geom = new THREE.TubeGeometry(path, Math.max(4, Math.ceil(len * 5)), r, 14, false);
      const color = COLORS[circuit];
      const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        uniforms: {
          uColor: { value: color },
          uOff: { value: color.clone().lerp(offBase, 0.72) },
          uOn: { value: 0 }, uDir: { value: 1 }, uLen: { value: len }, uTime: flowTime,
          uSpeed: flowStyle.speed, uSpacing: flowStyle.spacing, uGlow: flowStyle.glow, uMute: flowStyle.mute, uOnLevel: flowStyle.onLevel,
          uFog: { value: fogColor }, uFogNear: { value: 110 }, uFogFar: { value: 220 },
        },
        vertexShader: pipeVS,
        fragmentShader: pipeFS,
      });
      disposables.push(mat, geom);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      scene.add(mesh);
      runs[id] = { mat, target: 0, dir: 1 };
      return runs[id];
    }

    const headers = {};
    function addHeader(id, circuit, y, z, taps, radius) {
      const r = radius || 0.32;
      const sorted = taps.slice().sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
      const segs = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < sorted.length - 1; k++) {
        if (sorted[k + 1].x - sorted[k].x < 1e-3) continue;
        const segId = id + '#' + k;
        addRun(segId, circuit, [[sorted[k].x, y, z], [sorted[k + 1].x, y, z]], r);
        segs.push({ id: segId, lo: sorted[k].x, hi: sorted[k + 1].x });
      }
      const capMat = std(COLORS[circuit].clone().lerp(offBase, 0.55), 0.5, 0.3);
      [sorted[0].x, sorted[sorted.length - 1].x].forEach((x) => add(scene, new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 1.02, 18, 12), capMat, x, y, z));
      headers[id] = { taps: sorted, segs };
    }

    // roles: { tapKey: 'src' | 'sink' }. A segment carries flow when a source and a sink sit on opposite sides.
    function setHeader(id, roles) {
      const h = headers[id];
      h.segs.forEach((seg) => {
        let srcL = false, srcR = false, sinkL = false, sinkR = false;
        h.taps.forEach((t) => {
          const role = roles[t.key];
          if (!role) return;
          const left = t.x <= seg.lo + 1e-3;
          if (role === 'src') { if (left) srcL = true; else srcR = true; }
          if (role === 'sink') { if (left) sinkL = true; else sinkR = true; }
        });
        const fwd = srcL && sinkR, back = srcR && sinkL;
        setRun(seg.id, fwd || back, fwd ? 1 : -1);
      });
    }
    function setRun(id, on, dir) {
      const r = runs[id];
      if (!r) return;
      r.target = on ? 1 : 0;
      if (on) r.mat.uniforms.uDir.value = dir === -1 ? -1 : 1;
    }

    /* headers */
    addHeader('cws', 'cws', 2.0, -14, [
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'cwp' + (i + 1), x })),
      ...TOWER_X.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'ct' + (i + 1), x: x + 3.5 })),
    ]);
    addHeader('cwd', 'cws', 4.0, -7, [
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'cwp' + (i + 1), x })),
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'chiller' + (i + 1), x: x + 0.3 })),
    ]);
    addHeader('cwr', 'cwr', 5.6, -5.4, [
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'chiller' + (i + 1), x: x - 0.3 })),
      { key: 'riser', x: -19 },
    ]);
    addHeader('ctin', 'cwr', 10.2, -24.6, [
      { key: 'riser', x: -19 },
      ...TOWER_X.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'ct' + (i + 1), x: x - 2.5 })),
    ]);
    addHeader('chwr', 'chwr', 2.0, 14, [
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'chwp' + (i + 1), x })),
      { key: 'bypass', x: BYPASS_X }, { key: 'bldg', x: BLDG_TAP_X },

    addHeader('chwd', 'chwr', 4.0, 7, [
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'chwp' + (i + 1), x })),
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'chiller' + (i + 1), x: x + 0.3 })),
    ]);
    addHeader('chws', 'chws', 5.6, 5.4, [
      ...COL.map((x, i) => ({ key: 'chiller' + (i + 1), x: x - 0.3 })),
      { key: 'bypass', x: BYPASS_X }, { key: 'bldg', x: BLDG_TAP_X },

    /* branches, authored in the direction water physically flows */
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      const x = COL[i - 1], tx = TOWER_X[i - 1];
      addRun('ctout' + i, 'cws', [[tx + 3.5, DECK_Y + 0.4, TOWER_Z + 3], [tx + 3.5, DECK_Y + 0.4, -14], [tx + 3.5, 2.0, -14]]);
      addRun('cwpsuc' + i, 'cws', [[x, 2.0, -14], [x, 0.78, -14], [x, 0.78, CWP_Z - 0.9]]);
      addRun('cwpdis' + i, 'cws', [[x, 1.45, CWP_Z], [x, 4.0, CWP_Z], [x, 4.0, -7]]);
      addRun('condin' + i, 'cws', [[x + 0.3, 4.0, -7], [x + 0.3, 4.0, -4.6], [x + 0.3, 2.3, -4.6], [x + 0.3, 2.3, -3.4]], 0.22);
      addRun('condout' + i, 'cwr', [[x - 0.3, 2.8, -3.4], [x - 0.3, 2.8, -5.4], [x - 0.3, 5.6, -5.4]], 0.22);
      addRun('ctin' + i, 'cwr', [[tx - 2.5, 10.2, -24.6], [tx - 2.5, 10.2, TOWER_Z - 2.6], [tx - 2.5, DECK_Y + 4.5, TOWER_Z - 2.6]]);
      addRun('chwpsuc' + i, 'chwr', [[x, 2.0, 14], [x, 0.78, 14], [x, 0.78, CHWP_Z + 0.9]]);
      addRun('chwpdis' + i, 'chwr', [[x, 1.45, CHWP_Z], [x, 4.0, CHWP_Z], [x, 4.0, 7]]);
      addRun('evapin' + i, 'chwr', [[x + 0.3, 4.0, 7], [x + 0.3, 4.0, 4.6], [x + 0.3, 0.85, 4.6], [x + 0.3, 0.85, 3.4]], 0.22);
      addRun('evapout' + i, 'chws', [[x - 0.3, 1.25, 3.4], [x - 0.3, 1.25, 5.4], [x - 0.3, 5.6, 5.4]], 0.22);
    }
    addRun('riser', 'cwr', [[-19, 5.6, -5.4], [-19, 5.6, -24.6], [-19, 10.2, -24.6]], 0.32);
    addRun('bldgsup', 'chws', [[BLDG_TAP_X, 5.6, 5.4], [BLDG_X - 3, 5.6, 5.4]], 0.32);
    addRun('bldgret', 'chwr', [[BLDG_X - 3, 2.0, 14], [BLDG_TAP_X, 2.0, 14]], 0.32);
    addRun('bypass', 'bypass', [[BYPASS_X, 5.6, 5.4], [BYPASS_X, 3.0, 5.4], [BYPASS_X, 3.0, 14], [BYPASS_X, 2.0, 14]], 0.2);

    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      const tx = TOWER_X[i - 1];
      buildValve('ct' + i + 'ValveOut', V3(tx + 3.5, DECK_Y + 0.4, -15.4), 'z', 0.9);
      buildValve('ct' + i + 'ValveIn', V3(tx - 2.5, 10.2, -23.7), 'z', 0.9);
    }
    buildValve('bypassValve1', V3(BYPASS_X, 3.0, 9.7), 'z', 0.8);

    /* ═════════════ tags (HTML overlays anchored to 3D points, de-overlapped every frame) ═════════════ */
    const SVGNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
    const leaderSvg = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, 'svg');
    leaderSvg.setAttribute('class', 'leaders');
    tagLayer.appendChild(leaderSvg);
    const tags = [];
    function makeTag(id, cls, html, anchor, key) {
      const el = document.createElement('div');

      el.id = id;
      el.innerHTML = html;
      if (key) {

      leaderSvg.appendChild(line);
      leaderSvg.appendChild(dot);
      const t = { el, line, dot, anchor, key, type: tagTypeOf(id), hidden: null, sx: null };
      tags.push(t);
      if (key && equip[key]) equip[key].tag = el;
      return t;
    }
    const num = (id, unit) => `<span id="${id}">--</span>${unit ? `<span class="u">${unit}</span>` : ''}`;
    const kv = (k, inner, attrs, title) => `<span class="kv ${attrs || ''}"${title ? ` title="${title}"` : ''}>${k ? `<span class="k">${k}</span>` : ''}<span class="v">${inner}</span></span>`;
    const meterKv = (k, id, valueId, unit, title) => `<span class="kv meter" id="${id}"${title ? ` title="${title}"` : ''}>${k ? `<span class="k">${k}</span>` : ''}<span class="v">${num(valueId, unit)}</span></span>`;

    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      makeTag('chiller-' + i, 'tag-chiller', `
        <div class="tag-head"><span class="tag-name">Chiller ${i}</span><span class="role" id="role-ch-${i}">-</span><span class="mode-badge" id="mode-ch-${i}-package" title="Package control mode">--</span><span class="mode-badge" id="mode-ch-${i}" title="Device control mode">--</span><span class="avail" id="availability-ch-${i}"></span></div>
        <div class="status-line"><span id="status-ch-${i}">--</span><span class="dur" id="duration-ch-${i}"></span></div>
        <div class="pairs">
          <span class="kv"><span class="k">Load</span><span class="v meter" id="reading-ch-${i}-estimated-load-rt">${num(`value-ch-${i}-estimated-load-rt`, 'RT')}</span></span>
          <span class="kv"><span class="k">RLA</span><span class="v" id="reading-ch-${i}-rla-percent">${num(`value-ch-${i}-rla-percent`, '%')}</span></span>
          <span class="kv"><span class="k">kW/RT</span><span class="v" id="reading-ch-${i}-kw-per-rt">${num(`value-ch-${i}-kw-per-rt`)}</span></span>
          <span class="kv"><span class="k">SP</span><span class="v">${num(`value-ch-${i}-sp`, '°C')}</span></span>
          <span class="kv full"><span class="k">Flow load</span><span class="v" id="reading-ch-${i}-load-rt">${num(`value-ch-${i}-load-rt`, 'RT')}</span></span>
        </div>
        <div class="rla-bar"><i id="rlabar-ch-${i}"></i></div>
        <div class="temps full"><span></span><span class="h">EWT °C</span><span class="h">LWT °C</span>
          <span class="k">Evap</span><span class="v" id="value-ch-${i}-evap-ewt">--</span><span class="v" id="value-ch-${i}-evap-lwt">--</span>
          <span class="k">Cond</span><span class="v" id="value-ch-${i}-cond-ewt">--</span><span class="v" id="value-ch-${i}-cond-lwt">--</span>
        </div>`, equip['chiller' + i].anchor, 'chiller' + i);

    /* ═════════════ camera + controls ═════════════ */
    const VIEWS = {
      overview: { target: V3(4, 2.5, -4), r: 74, theta: -0.5, phi: 0.98 },

    /* pointer input */
    const el = renderer.domElement;
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const ndc = new THREE.Vector2();

    let drag = null;
    function pickAt(clientX, clientY) {

      ndc.set(((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1, -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1);
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

    }
    el.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());
    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      pointers.set(e.pointerId, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        drag = { mode: e.button === 2 || e.shiftKey || e.ctrlKey ? 'pan' : 'rotate', x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, moved: 0 };
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {

      stage.classList.add('dragging');
    });
    el.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!drag) {
        if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') hoverQueued = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };

      }
      if (!pointers.has(e.pointerId)) return;
      pointers.set(e.pointerId, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });

        const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()];
        const d = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
        ctl.r = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(ctl.r * (drag.dist / Math.max(d, 1)), 7, 150);
        drag.dist = d;

      drag.x = e.clientX; drag.y = e.clientY;
      drag.moved += Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy);
      if (drag.moved > 4) clearViewPressed();
      if (drag.mode === 'rotate') {
        ctl.theta -= dx * 0.0055;
        ctl.phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(ctl.phi - dy * 0.0055, 0.12, 1.48);
      } else {
        const s = ctl.r * 0.0016;
        const right = V3(Math.cos(ctl.theta), 0, -Math.sin(ctl.theta));
        const fwd = V3(Math.sin(ctl.theta), 0, Math.cos(ctl.theta));
        ctl.target.addScaledVector(right, -dx * s).addScaledVector(fwd, -dy * s);

    });
    const endPointer = (e) => {
      const wasClick = drag && drag.mode !== 'pinch' && drag.moved < 5 && e.type === 'pointerup' && e.button === 0;
      pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
      if (pointers.size === 0) {
        drag = null;

    };
    el.addEventListener('pointerup', endPointer);
    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', endPointer);
    el.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      flight = null;
      ctl.r = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(ctl.r * Math.exp(e.deltaY * 0.0012), 7, 150);
      clearViewPressed();
    }, { passive: false });
    let hoverQueued = null;
    // double left-click anywhere in the 3D view: back to the plant overview
    el.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
      if (e.button !== 0) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      select(null);
      setView('overview');
    });

    root.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => { select(null); setView(b.dataset.view); }));
    ['cpms3d-detail', 'cpms3d-tagtoggle', 'staging-collapse', 'cpms3d-summary-toggle', 'summary-hide'].forEach((id) => q(id).addEventListener('click', () => { requestAnimationFrame(() => { measureTick = 0; }); }));

    /* ═════════════ resize / visibility ═════════════ */
    function resize() {
      const w = Math.max(root.clientWidth, 1);
      let h = root.clientHeight;
      if (h < 50) { h = Math.max(window.innerHeight, 420); root.style.height = h + 'px'; }

    ctl.r = VIEWS.overview.r * aspectBoost();

    let inView = true;
    const io = typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined'

    if (io) io.observe(root);

    /* ═════════════ per-frame state ═════════════ */
    const STATE_COLOR = {
      on: COLORS.run, open: COLORS.run, starting: COLORS.warn, stopping: COLORS.warn,
      trip: COLORS.bad, maintenance: COLORS.warn, standby: COLORS.standby, closed: COLORS.standby,
      disabled: COLORS.dim, unavailable: COLORS.dim,

    const tmpColor = new THREE.Color();
    const selColor = new THREE.Color(dark ? 0x6f8fb3 : 0x9db8d6);
    const tagVec = new THREE.Vector3();
    let last = performance.now();
    let raf = 0;
    let disposed = false;

    /* Tag layout: each tag prefers to sit just above its anchor. Overlapping tags are pushed apart,

    let measureTick = 0;
    let hudRects = [];
    const GAP = 20, PAD = 6;
    function measureTags() {
      const rr = root.getBoundingClientRect();
      hudRects = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.hud')).map((h) => {
        const b = h.getBoundingClientRect();

    function updateTags(dt) {

      const W = width, H = height;
      const vis = [];
      for (const t of tags) {
        tagVec.copy(t.anchor).project(camera);
        const ax = (tagVec.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * W;
        const ay = (-tagVec.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * H;
        const allowed = tagAllowed(t.el, t.type, !!(t.key && t.key === selectedKey));
        if (allowed) allowedCount += 1;
        const hide = !allowed || tagVec.z > 1 || ax < -40 || ax > W + 40 || ay < -40 || ay > H + 40;
        if (hide !== t.hidden) {
          t.el.classList.toggle('hidden', hide);

            if (ox <= 0) continue;
            const oy = Math.min(a.sy + a.h, b.sy + b.h) - Math.max(a.sy, b.sy) + PAD;
            if (oy <= 0) continue;
            const wsum = a.weight + b.weight;
            if (ox < oy * (it < ITER - SETTLE ? 2.4 : 1.2)) {          // prefer separating sideways
              const s = (a.sx + a.w / 2) < (b.sx + b.w / 2) || ((a.sx + a.w / 2) === (b.sx + b.w / 2) && a.ax <= b.ax) ? -1 : 1;

            if (t.sx + t.w <= r.x || t.sx >= r.x + r.w || t.sy + t.h <= r.y || t.sy >= r.y + r.h) continue;

        t.px += (t.sx - t.px) * k;

        const x = Math.round(t.px), y = Math.round(t.py);

        const cx = Math.max(t.px, Math.min(t.ax, t.px + t.w));

        t.line.setAttribute('x1', cx.toFixed(1)); t.line.setAttribute('y1', cy.toFixed(1));

        t.dot.setAttribute('cx', t.ax.toFixed(1)); t.dot.setAttribute('cy', t.ay.toFixed(1));
        const sel = t.key && t.key === selectedKey;

        t.dot.classList.toggle('sel', !!sel);

      if (allowedCount !== lastAllowedCount) { lastAllowedCount = allowedCount; onTagCountChange(allowedCount, tags.length); }

    let lastFar = null;
    let lastAllowedCount = -1;

    function frame(now) {
      if (disposed) return;

      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1);
      last = now;

      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(now * 0.008);

      const tripOn = Math.sin(now * 0.0075) > 0;

        const r = runs[id];

        u.value += (r.target - u.value) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.5);

        const rec = equip[key];

        let k = 0.05;
        if (rec.state === 'on' || rec.state === 'open') k = 0.85;
        else if (rec.state === 'starting' || rec.state === 'stopping') k = blink;
        else if (rec.state === 'trip') k = tripOn ? 1 : 0.1;

        for (const s of rec.spinners) {
          const target = (rec.speedHz || 0) * s.rate * Math.PI * 2 * (reducedMotion ? 0.3 : 1);

        ctl.phi = flight.from.phi + (flight.to.phi - flight.from.phi) * e;

    function dispose() {

    /* ═════════════ public API used by the telemetry layer ═════════════ */

      setRla(key, rla, thresholdState) {

      },

  /* ═════════════ apply a device list to the tags and the 3D scene ═════════════ */
  let view3d = null;
  let pendingPayload = null;

  function equipState({ running, trip, starting, stopping, availability, status }) {
    if (trip) return 'trip';
    if (starting) return 'starting';
    if (stopping) return 'stopping';
    if (running) return 'on';
    if (availability === 'MAINTENANCE') return 'maintenance';
    if (availability === 'DISABLED') return 'disabled';
    if (status === 'UNAVAILABLE') return 'unavailable';

  }
  const STATE_CLASSES = ['on', 'off', 'trip', 'starting', 'stopping', 'standby', 'maintenance', 'disabled', 'unavailable'];
  function setTagState(id, state) {
    const el = q(id);
