    STATE_CLASSES.forEach((c) => el.classList.toggle(c, c === state || (c === 'off' && state === 'standby')));
  }

  function updateDashboardUI(payload) {
    if (!payload) return;
    if (!view3d) { pendingPayload = payload; return; }
    const dm = {};
    (payload.devices || []).forEach((d) => { if (d && d.deviceId) dm[d.deviceId] = d; });

    const isPumpRunning = (p) => p?.effectiveRun === true && Number(p.effectiveSpeedCmd || 0) > 0;
    const run = (id) => isPumpRunning(dm[id]);
    const vOpen = (id) => dm[id]?.opened === true;
    const anyCwp = ['cwp1', 'cwp2', 'cwp3'].some(run);
    const anyChwp = ['chwp1', 'chwp2', 'chwp3'].some(run);
    const anyValveOut = [1, 2, 3].some((i) => vOpen(`ct${i}ValveOut`));
    const anyValveIn = [1, 2, 3].some((i) => vOpen(`ct${i}ValveIn`));
    const bypassOpen = dm.bypassValve1?.opened === true;

    const cwFlow = {}, chwFlow = {};
    Object.keys(cwpMap).forEach((p) => { if (run(p)) cwpMap[p].forEach((c) => { cwFlow[c] = true; }); });
    Object.keys(chwpMap).forEach((p) => { if (run(p)) chwpMap[p].forEach((c) => { chwFlow[c] = true; }); });

    /* ── piping ── */
    const S = view3d;
    const roles = { cws: {}, cwd: {}, cwr: {}, ctin: {}, chwr: {}, chwd: {}, chws: {} };
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      const ch = 'chiller' + i;
      const ctOut = anyCwp && vOpen(`ct${i}ValveOut`);
      const ctIn = anyCwp && vOpen(`ct${i}ValveIn`);
      S.setRun('ctout' + i, ctOut, 1);
      S.setRun('ctin' + i, ctIn, 1);
      if (ctOut) roles.cws['ct' + i] = 'src';
      if (ctIn) roles.ctin['ct' + i] = 'sink';

      const cwp = run('cwp' + i);
      S.setRun('cwpsuc' + i, cwp && anyValveOut, 1);
      S.setRun('cwpdis' + i, cwp, 1);
      if (cwp && anyValveOut) roles.cws['cwp' + i] = 'sink';
      if (cwp) roles.cwd['cwp' + i] = 'src';

      S.setRun('condin' + i, !!cwFlow[ch], 1);
      S.setRun('condout' + i, !!cwFlow[ch] && anyValveIn, 1);
      if (cwFlow[ch]) roles.cwd[ch] = 'sink';
      if (cwFlow[ch] && anyValveIn) roles.cwr[ch] = 'src';

      const chwp = run('chwp' + i);
      S.setRun('chwpsuc' + i, chwp, 1);
      S.setRun('chwpdis' + i, chwp, 1);
      if (chwp) { roles.chwr['chwp' + i] = 'sink'; roles.chwd['chwp' + i] = 'src'; }

      S.setRun('evapin' + i, !!chwFlow[ch], 1);
      S.setRun('evapout' + i, !!chwFlow[ch], 1);
      if (chwFlow[ch]) { roles.chwd[ch] = 'sink'; roles.chws[ch] = 'src'; }
    }
    const cwReturn = anyCwp && anyValveIn;
    S.setRun('riser', cwReturn, 1);
    if (cwReturn) { roles.cwr.riser = 'sink'; roles.ctin.riser = 'src'; }
    S.setRun('bldgsup', anyChwp, 1);
    S.setRun('bldgret', anyChwp, 1);
    if (anyChwp) { roles.chwr.bldg = 'src'; roles.chws.bldg = 'sink'; }
    S.setRun('bypass', bypassOpen && anyChwp, 1);
    if (bypassOpen && anyChwp) { roles.chws.bypass = 'sink'; roles.chwr.bypass = 'src'; }
    Object.keys(roles).forEach((h) => S.setHeader(h, roles[h]));

    /* ── cooling towers, fans, valves ── */
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      const tower = dm['ct' + i];
      let anyFanOn = false, anyFanTrip = false;
      ['a', 'b'].forEach((l, k) => {
        const fan = dm[`ct${i}Fan${k + 1}`];
        if (!fan) return;
        const speed = Number(fan.effectiveSpeedCmd || 0);
        const running = speed > 0 || fan.effectiveRun === true;
        const trip = fan.trip === true;
        anyFanOn = anyFanOn || (running && !trip);
        anyFanTrip = anyFanTrip || trip;
        updateModeBadge(`mode-ct-${i}${l}`, fan.controlMode);
        setText(`value-ct-${i}${l}-fan-hz`, speed.toFixed(0));
        const fanEl = q(`ct-${i}${l}`);
        toggleCls(fanEl, 'on', running && !trip);
        toggleCls(fanEl, 'off', !running);
        toggleCls(fanEl, 'trip', trip);
        S.setEquip(`ct${i}Fan${k + 1}`, trip ? 'trip' : running ? 'on' : equipState({ availability: fan.availability, status: fan.status }), { speedHz: running && !trip ? speed : 0 });
      });
      if (tower) {
        setText(`role-ct-${i}`, tower.priorityRole || 'excluded');
        updateModeBadge(`mode-ct-${i}-package`, tower.controlMode);
        updateAvailabilityIcon(`availability-ct-${i}`, tower.availability, tower.status);
      }
      const towerState = anyFanTrip ? 'trip' : anyFanOn ? 'on' : equipState({ availability: tower?.availability, status: tower?.status });
      setTagState(`tower-ct-${i}`, towerState);
      S.setEquip('ct' + i, towerState);

      ['ValveIn', 'ValveOut'].forEach((v) => {
        const d = dm[`ct${i}${v}`];
        if (!d) return;
        const open = d.opened === true || d.requestedOpen === true;
        updateModeBadge(`mode-ct${i}-valve-${v === 'ValveIn' ? 'in' : 'out'}`, d.controlMode);
        const pill = q(`tagv-ct${i}${v}`);
        if (pill) {
          pill.classList.toggle('on', open);
          pill.querySelector('.vstate').textContent = open ? 'Open' : 'Closed';
        }
        S.setEquip(`ct${i}${v}`, open ? 'open' : 'closed');
      });
    }

    /* ── pumps ── */
    ['cwp', 'chwp'].forEach((kind) => {
      for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        const pump = dm[kind + i];
        if (!pump) continue;
        const speed = Number(pump.effectiveSpeedCmd || 0);
        const running = isPumpRunning(pump);
        const trip = pump.trip === true;
        setMeterValue(`value-${kind}-${i}-flow-m3h`, `reading-${kind}-${i}-flow-m3h`, pump.flowRate, 0);
        setMeterValue(`value-${kind}-${i}-pressure-bar`, `reading-${kind}-${i}-pressure-bar`, pump.pressure, 1);
        toggleCls(q(`reading-${kind}-${i}-flow-m3h`), 'off', !running);
        setText(`value-pump-${kind}-${i}-hz`, speed.toFixed(0));
        updateModeBadge(`mode-${kind}-${i}`, pump.controlMode);
        const state = equipState({ running, trip, availability: pump.availability, status: pump.status });
        setTagState(`pump-${kind}-${i}`, state);
        S.setEquip(kind + i, state, { speedHz: running && !trip ? speed : 0 });
      }
    });

    /* ── chillers ── */
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      const c = dm['chiller' + i];
      if (!c) continue;
      const kwPerRt = Number(c.efficiencyKwPerRt || 0);
      setMeterValue(`value-ch-${i}-estimated-load-rt`, `reading-ch-${i}-estimated-load-rt`, c.estimatedLoadRt, 1);
      setText(`value-ch-${i}-load-rt`, Number(c.coolingLoad || 0).toFixed(1));
      setText(`value-ch-${i}-kw-per-rt`, kwPerRt > 0 ? kwPerRt.toFixed(2) : '0.00');
      setText(`value-ch-${i}-rla-percent`, Number(c.rlaPercent || 0).toFixed(1));
      setMeterValue(`value-ch-${i}-evap-ewt`, null, c.evapEWT, 1);
      setMeterValue(`value-ch-${i}-evap-lwt`, null, c.evapLWT, 1);
      setMeterValue(`value-ch-${i}-cond-ewt`, null, c.condEWT, 1);
      setMeterValue(`value-ch-${i}-cond-lwt`, null, c.condLWT, 1);
      setText(`value-ch-${i}-sp`, Number(c.setPoint || 0).toFixed(2));

      const rlaState = chillerThreshold('rla', c.rlaPercent, c);
      setThresholdStatus(`reading-ch-${i}-kw-per-rt`, chillerThreshold('efficiency', c.efficiencyKwPerRt, c));
      setThresholdStatus(`reading-ch-${i}-rla-percent`, rlaState);
      setThresholdStatus(`value-ch-${i}-evap-ewt`, chillerThreshold('evapEWT', c.evapEWT, c));
      setThresholdStatus(`value-ch-${i}-evap-lwt`, chillerThreshold('evapLWT', c.evapLWT, c));
      setThresholdStatus(`value-ch-${i}-cond-ewt`, chillerThreshold('condEWT', c.condEWT, c));
      setThresholdStatus(`value-ch-${i}-cond-lwt`, chillerThreshold('condLWT', c.condLWT, c));
      const bar = q(`rlabar-ch-${i}`);
      if (bar) {
        bar.style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(c.rlaPercent || 0))) + '%';
        bar.style.background = rlaState === 'bad' ? 'var(--bad)' : rlaState === 'warn' ? 'var(--warn)' : rlaState === 'good' ? 'var(--run)' : 'var(--standby)';
      }

      const isTransitioning = c.packageStatus === 'STARTING' || c.packageStatus === 'STOPPING';
      const currentStatus = c.trip ? 'TRIPPED' : isTransitioning ? c.packageStatus : c.physicalState;
      setText(`role-ch-${i}`, c.priorityRole || 'excluded');
      updateModeBadge(`mode-ch-${i}-package`, c.packageMode);
      updateAvailabilityIcon(`availability-ch-${i}`, c.availability, c.packageStatus || c.status);
      updateModeBadge(`mode-ch-${i}`, c.controlMode);
      setText(`status-ch-${i}`, currentStatus);
      setText(`duration-ch-${i}`, formatChillerStateDuration(c.packageStatus, c.stateChangedAt));

      const state = equipState({
        running: c.physicalState === 'RUNNING' && !isTransitioning,
        trip: c.trip === true,
        starting: c.packageStatus === 'STARTING',
        stopping: c.packageStatus === 'STOPPING',
        availability: c.availability,
        status: c.packageStatus || c.status,
      });
      setTagState(`chiller-${i}`, state);
      S.setEquip('chiller' + i, state);
      S.setRla('chiller' + i, c.effectiveRun ? Number(c.rlaPercent || 0) : 0, rlaState);
    }

    /* ── bypass valve ── */
    const bp = dm.bypassValve1;
    if (bp) {
      setText('reading-sv-bar', Number(bp.sv || 0).toFixed(1));
      setText('reading-pv-bar', Number(bp.pv || 0).toFixed(1));
      setText('reading-mv-percent', Number(bp.mv || 0).toFixed(0));
      S.setEquip('bypassValve1', bp.opened ? 'open' : 'closed');
      setTagState('tag-bypass', bp.opened ? 'on' : 'standby');
    }

    /* ── headers ── */
    const chw = dm.chwpHeader;
    if (chw) {
      const activeSetpoint = ['chiller1', 'chiller2', 'chiller3'].map((id) => dm[id])
        .find((c) => c?.effectiveRun === true && numericReading(c.setPoint) !== null)?.setPoint;
      setText('reading-building-chws-temp-c', formatValue(chw.chws, 1));
      setText('reading-building-chwr-temp-c', formatValue(chw.chwr, 1));
      setThresholdStatus('reading-building-chws-temp-c', headerThreshold('chws', chw.chws, chw, activeSetpoint));
      setThresholdStatus('reading-building-chwr-temp-c', headerThreshold('chwr', chw.chwr, chw));
      setText('value-building-load-rt', Number(chw.coolingLoad || 0).toFixed(1));
      setMeterValue('value-chws-header-pressure-bar', 'reading-chws-header-pressure-bar', chw.supplyPressure, 1);
      setMeterValue('value-chws-header-flow-m3h', 'reading-chws-header-flow-m3h', chw.flowRate, 0);
      setMeterValue('value-chwr-header-pressure-bar', 'reading-chwr-header-pressure-bar', chw.returnPressure, 1);
    }
    const cw = dm.cwpHeader;
    if (cw) {
      setText('reading-cws-header-temp-c', formatValue(cw.cws, 1));
      setText('reading-cwr-header-temp-c', formatValue(cw.cwr, 1));
      setThresholdStatus('reading-cws-header-temp-c', headerThreshold('cws', cw.cws, cw));
      setThresholdStatus('reading-cwr-header-temp-c', headerThreshold('cwr', cw.cwr, cw));
      setMeterValue('value-cws-header-pressure-bar', 'reading-cws-header-pressure-bar', cw.supplyPressure ?? cw.pressure, 1);
      setMeterValue('value-cwr-header-pressure-bar', 'reading-cwr-header-pressure-bar', cw.returnPressure ?? cw.pressure, 1);
      setMeterValue('value-cwr-header-flow-m3h', 'reading-cwr-header-flow-m3h', cw.flowRate, 0);
    }
  }

  function handleMessage(raw) {
    try {
      const payload = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
      const dashboardPayload = toDashboardPayload(payload);
      if (dashboardPayload?.devices) updateDashboardUI(dashboardPayload);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('CPMS 3D: failed to handle telemetry message', err);
    }
  }

  /* ═════════════ telemetry (one shared connection per page, from cpms-core.js) ═════════════ */
  function resolveCpmsWebSocketUrl() {
    const grafanaUrl = '${cpms_telemetry_ws_url}';
    const configuredUrl = grafanaUrl && !grafanaUrl.includes('${')
      ? grafanaUrl
      : ((typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.CPMS_TELEMETRY_WS_URL) || '');
    if (configuredUrl) return configuredUrl;
    const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
    return protocol + '//' + window.location.host + '/telemetry/live';
  }
  const socketUrl = resolveCpmsWebSocketUrl();

  function setWsStatus(state, label) {

    s.classList.remove('connected', 'connecting', 'offline', 'demo');
    s.classList.add(state);
    setText('ws-status-text', label);

  function connectTelemetry() {
    window.CPMS.telemetry.subscribe(socketUrl, {
      alive: () => root.isConnected,
      onStatus: (state) => {
        if (demoTimer) return;
        if (state === 'connected') setWsStatus('connected', 'Live');
        else if (state === 'connecting') setWsStatus('connecting', 'Connecting');
        else setWsStatus('offline', 'Offline');

      onMessage: (payload) => {

        stopDemo();
        setWsStatus('connected', 'Live');
        handleMessage(payload);
      },
    });
  }

  /* ═════════════ demo data (preview outside Grafana; never starts inside Grafana unless forced) ═════════════ */
  let demoTimer = null;
  const demoTrip = params.get('cpmsDemoTrip') === '1' || window.CPMS_DEMO_TRIP === true;
  const demoStart = Date.now();
  function stopDemo() {
    if (!demoTimer) return;
    clearInterval(demoTimer);
    demoTimer = null;
  }
  function startDemo() {
    if (demoTimer || liveDataSeen) return;
    setWsStatus('demo', 'Demo data');
    const tick = () => { if (!root.isConnected) { stopDemo(); return; } handleMessage(buildDemoPayload((Date.now() - demoStart) / 1000)); };
    tick();
    demoTimer = setInterval(tick, 2000);
    lastSummaryOk = 0;
    loadSummary();
  }
  let demoLoad = 860;
  function buildDemoSummary() {
    const now = new Date();
    const hours = now.getHours() + now.getMinutes() / 60;
    const totalPower = demoLoad * 0.71;
    return {
      timestamp: now.getTime(), totalRt: demoLoad, totalPower, plantKwPerRt: totalPower / demoLoad,
      rthToday: 820 * hours, rthYesterday: 19840, rthLastWeekSameDay: 20310, rthDiffPercent: 0.023,
    };
  }
  function buildDemoPayload(t) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const wave = (amp, period, phase) => amp * Math.sin((t / period) * Math.PI * 2 + (phase || 0));
    // 90 s cycle: chiller 3 stages up at 60 s, runs, then stages back down
    const c = t % 90;
    const ch3Starting = c >= 60 && c < 66;
    const ch3Running = c >= 66 && c < 84;
    const ch3Stopping = c >= 84 && c < 88;
    const p3On = c >= 58 && c < 88;
    const ct3On = c >= 60 && c < 86;
    const load = 860 + wave(70, 40) + (ch3Running ? 180 : 0);
    demoLoad = load;
    const nRun = ch3Running ? 3 : 2;
    const perCh = load / nRun;
    const setpoint = 6.7;
    const chws = setpoint + 0.05 + wave(0.08, 13);
    const chwr = chws + 5.4 + wave(0.3, 21);
    const cws = 29.3 + wave(0.4, 33);
    const cwr = cws + 5.2 + wave(0.3, 17);

    const chiller = (n, running, state, priority) => ({
      chillerId: 'chiller' + n,
      state, stateChangedAt: now - (n === 3 ? 30 * 1000 : (3 + n) * 3600 * 1000),
      controlMode: 'AUTO', availability: 'AVAILABLE',
      estimatedLoadRt: running ? perCh + wave(8, 11, n) : 0,
      rlaPercent: running ? 62 + perCh / 18 + wave(3, 9, n) : 0,
      efficiencyKwPerRt: running ? 0.62 + wave(0.04, 27, n) : 0,
      chiller: {
        state: running ? 'RUNNING' : 'OFF', mode: 'AUTO', setpoint, telemetryQuality: 'GOOD',
        evapEWT: running ? chwr : chws + 3, evapLWT: running ? chws + wave(0.04, 7, n) : chws + 3,
        condEWT: running ? cws : cws - 1, condLWT: running ? cwr : cws - 1, power: running ? perCh * 0.62 : 0,
      },
      cwPump: { deviceId: 'cwp' + n, flowRate: running || (n === 3 && p3On) ? 640 + wave(15, 19, n) : 0 },
      chwPump: { deviceId: 'chwp' + n, flowRate: (running || (n === 3 && p3On)) && !(demoTrip && n === 2) ? 520 + wave(15, 23, n) : 0, energyFlowRate: running ? perCh / 78.986 : 0 },
      priority,
    });
    let tripPump = null;
    const pump = (id, on, hz, pressure) => ({
      deviceId: id, state: on ? 'RUNNING' : 'OFF', commanded: on ? 'START' : 'STOP',
      speedFb: on ? hz : 0, mode: 'AUTO', availability: 'AVAILABLE', pressure: on ? pressure : 0.4,
    });
    const towerFanHz = 36 + wave(4, 29);
    const tower = (n, on) => ({
      towerId: 'ct' + n, state: on ? 'RUNNING' : 'OFF', controlMode: 'AUTO', availability: 'AVAILABLE',
      fans: [1, 2].map((f) => ({ deviceId: `ct${n}Fan${f}`, state: on ? 'RUNNING' : 'OFF', speedFb: on ? towerFanHz + f : 0, mode: 'AUTO', availability: 'AVAILABLE' })),
      valves: [
        { deviceId: `ct${n}ValveIn`, state: on ? 'OPEN' : 'CLOSED', mode: 'AUTO' },
        { deviceId: `ct${n}ValveOut`, state: on ? 'OPEN' : 'CLOSED', mode: 'AUTO' },
      ],
    });
    // ?cpmsDemoTrip=1 (or window.CPMS_DEMO_TRIP = true): CHWP 2 and Tower 2 fan A sit in a tripped state
    if (demoTrip) {
      tripPump = { deviceId: 'chwp2', state: 'FAULT', commanded: 'START', trip: true, reason: 'VFD overcurrent trip', speedFb: 0, mode: 'AUTO', availability: 'AVAILABLE', pressure: 0.4 };
    }
    const ch3State = ch3Starting ? 'STARTING' : ch3Running ? 'RUNNING' : ch3Stopping ? 'STOPPING' : 'OFF';
    const chillers = {
      chiller1: chiller(1, true, 'RUNNING'),
      chiller2: chiller(2, true, 'RUNNING'),
      chiller3: chiller(3, ch3Running, ch3State),
    };
    const loadLimit = 1020;
    return {
      type: 'plant-state',
      alarms: { summary: demoTrip ? { total: 3, critical: 2, warning: 1, info: 0 } : { total: 1, critical: 0, warning: 1, info: 0 } },
      data: {
        timestamp: now, state: 'RUNNING', health: 'OK', controlMode: 'AUTO', plantMode: 'NORMAL',
        requiredChillers: ch3Starting || ch3Running ? 3 : 2, requiredCoolingTowers: ct3On ? 3 : 2,
        chillers,
        chillerPriority: { chiller1: 'LEAD', chiller2: 'LAG', chiller3: 'STANDBY' },
        coolingTowerPriority: { ct1: 'LEAD', ct2: 'LAG', ct3: 'STANDBY' },
        cwPumps: { cwp1: pump('cwp1', true, 44 + wave(1, 15), 2.6), cwp2: pump('cwp2', true, 44 + wave(1, 15, 1), 2.6), cwp3: pump('cwp3', p3On, 43, 2.5) },
        chwPumps: { chwp1: pump('chwp1', true, 41 + wave(2, 18), 3.1), chwp2: tripPump || pump('chwp2', true, 41 + wave(2, 18, 1), 3.1), chwp3: pump('chwp3', p3On, 40, 3.0) },
        coolingTowers: (() => {
          const towers = { ct1: tower(1, true), ct2: tower(2, true), ct3: tower(3, ct3On) };
          if (demoTrip) Object.assign(towers.ct2.fans[0], { state: 'FAULT', trip: true, reason: 'Motor overload trip', speedFb: 0 });
          return towers;
        })(),
        bypassValve: { sv: 1.2, pv: 1.2 + wave(0.05, 11), mv: Math.max(0, 9 + wave(6, 25)) },
        chwHeader: { chws, chwr, flowRate: 1040 + (p3On ? 520 : 0) + wave(25, 23), supplyPressure: 3.0 + wave(0.05, 9), returnPressure: 1.7 + wave(0.04, 9), coolingLoad: load },
        cwHeader: { cws, cwr, flowRate: 1280 + (p3On ? 640 : 0) + wave(25, 19), supplyPressure: 2.5 + wave(0.05, 7), returnPressure: 1.5 + wave(0.04, 7) },
        outdoor: { temperature: 32.4 + wave(0.6, 60), humidity: 71 + wave(3, 80), radiation: 640 + wave(60, 45), telemetryQuality: 'GOOD' },
        staging: {
          chiller: {
            stageUp: {
              load: { value: load, limit: loadLimit, active: load > loadLimit * 0.97 || (c >= 50 && c < 60), elapsedMs: c >= 50 && c < 60 ? (c - 50) * 1000 * 30 : 0, delayMs: 300000 },
              chws: { value: chws, limit: 7.5, active: false, elapsedMs: 0, delayMs: 600000 },
              rla: { value: 62 + perCh / 18, limit: 95, active: false, elapsedMs: 0, delayMs: 600000 },
            },
            stageDown: {
              load: { value: load, limit: 560, active: false, elapsedMs: 0, delayMs: 900000 },
              chws: { value: chws, limit: 6.0, active: false, elapsedMs: 0, delayMs: 900000 },
            },
            hold: ch3Starting || (c >= 66 && c < 76) ? { active: true, remainingMs: Math.max(0, (76 - c) * 1000 * 60) } : { active: false },
          },
        },
      },
    };
  }

  const tagBtn = q('cpms3d-tagtoggle');
  const tagMenu = q('cpms3d-tag-menu');
  const tfShow = q('cpms3d-tf-show');
  const tfBody = q('cpms3d-tf-body');
  const tfTypeInputs = Array.from(tagMenu.querySelectorAll('[data-tf-type]'));
  const tfModeInputs = Array.from(tagMenu.querySelectorAll('input[name="cpms3d-tf-mode"]'));
  const filterNote = q('cpms3d-filter-note');

  function syncTagMenu() {
    tfShow.checked = tagFilter.show;
    tfBody.classList.toggle('off', !tagFilter.show);
    tfTypeInputs.forEach((i) => { i.checked = !!tagFilter.types[i.dataset.tfType]; });
    tfModeInputs.forEach((i) => { i.checked = i.value === tagFilter.mode; });
    tagBtn.classList.toggle('filtered', !tagFilterIsDefault());
  }
  function saveTagFilter() {
    try { window.localStorage.setItem('cpms3d.tagFilter', JSON.stringify(tagFilter)); } catch (_) { /* storage unavailable */ }
  }
  function loadTagFilter() {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem('cpms3d.tagFilter') || 'null');
      if (!saved) return;
      tagFilter.show = saved.show !== false;
      TAG_TYPES.forEach((t) => { tagFilter.types[t] = !saved.types || saved.types[t] !== false; });
      tagFilter.mode = ['all', 'running', 'exceptions'].includes(saved.mode) ? saved.mode : 'all';
    } catch (_) { /* ignore a corrupt saved value */ }
  }
  let lastTagCount = [0, 0];
  function tagFilterChanged() { syncTagMenu(); saveTagFilter(); onTagCountChange(lastTagCount[0], lastTagCount[1]); }
  // called by the tag layout whenever the number of allowed tags changes
  function onTagCountChange(shown, total) {
    lastTagCount = [shown, total];
    q('cpms3d-tag-count').textContent = tagFilterIsDefault() ? '' : shown + '/' + total;
    const empty = tagFilter.show && tagFilter.mode === 'exceptions' && shown === 0;
    if (empty) {
      filterNote.textContent = TAG_TYPES.every((t) => tagFilter.types[t])
        ? 'Exceptions only: nothing needs attention'
        : 'Exceptions only: nothing needs attention in the selected equipment';
    }
    filterNote.hidden = !empty;
  }

  function setTagMenuOpen(open) {
    tagMenu.hidden = !open;
    tagBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open) tfShow.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  tagBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setTagMenuOpen(tagMenu.hidden); });
  tagMenu.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (!tagMenu.hidden && !tagMenu.contains(e.target) && e.target !== tagBtn) setTagMenuOpen(false);
  });
  root.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !tagMenu.hidden) { setTagMenuOpen(false); tagBtn.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
  });
  tfShow.addEventListener('change', () => { tagFilter.show = tfShow.checked; tagFilterChanged(); });
  tfTypeInputs.forEach((i) => i.addEventListener('change', () => { tagFilter.types[i.dataset.tfType] = i.checked; tagFilterChanged(); }));
  tfModeInputs.forEach((i) => i.addEventListener('change', () => { if (i.checked) { tagFilter.mode = i.value; tagFilterChanged(); } }));
  q('cpms3d-tf-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    tagFilter.show = true;
    tagFilter.mode = 'all';
    TAG_TYPES.forEach((t) => { tagFilter.types[t] = true; });
    tagFilterChanged();
  });
  loadTagFilter();
  syncTagMenu();

  /* ═════════════ plant performance summary (same endpoint and rules as the summary panel) ═════════════ */
  const summaryEl = q('cpms3d-summary');
  const summaryToggle = q('cpms3d-summary-toggle');
  const SUMMARY_URL = window.CPMS_SUMMARY_URL || '/cpms/telemetry/summary';
  const SUMMARY_REFRESH_MS = 60000;
  const SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000;
  const integerFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  const decimalFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  const percentFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { style: 'percent', minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1, signDisplay: 'always' });
  const finiteNumber = (value) => (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null);
  const formatSummary = (value, formatter) => { const n = finiteNumber(value); return n === null ? '—' : formatter.format(n); };

  const efficiencyRating = (value) => rules().efficiencyRating(value);
  function renderSummary(summary) {
    const efficiency = finiteNumber(summary.plantKwPerRt);
    const rating = efficiencyRating(efficiency);
    setText('total-rt', formatSummary(summary.totalRt, integerFormatter));
    setText('total-power', formatSummary(summary.totalPower, integerFormatter));
    setText('plant-efficiency', formatSummary(efficiency, decimalFormatter));
    setText('rth-today', formatSummary(summary.rthToday, integerFormatter));
    setText('rth-yesterday', formatSummary(summary.rthYesterday, integerFormatter));
    setText('rth-last-week', formatSummary(summary.rthLastWeekSameDay, integerFormatter));
    setText('rth-change', finiteNumber(summary.rthDiffPercent) === null ? '—' : percentFormatter.format(-summary.rthDiffPercent));
    const card = q('efficiency-card');
    card.classList.remove('good', 'warn', 'bad');
    if (rating.className) card.classList.add(rating.className);
    setText('efficiency-rating', rating.label);
  }
  function setSummaryStatus(message, isError) {
    const el = q('summary-status');
    el.textContent = message;
    el.classList.toggle('error', !!isError);
  }

  let summaryLoading = false;
  let lastSummaryOk = 0;
  async function loadSummary() {
    if (summaryLoading || !root.isConnected || summaryEl.hidden || !window.CPMS) return;
    if (demoTimer) {
      renderSummary(buildDemoSummary());
      lastSummaryOk = Date.now();
      setSummaryStatus('Demo data, updated ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      return;
    }
    summaryLoading = true;
    const controller = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' ? new AbortController() : null;
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller && controller.abort(), SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(SUMMARY_URL, {
        credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }, cache: 'no-store',
        signal: controller ? controller.signal : undefined,
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
      const summary = await response.json();
      renderSummary(summary);
      lastSummaryOk = Date.now();
      setSummaryStatus('Live, updated ' + new Date(summary.timestamp || lastSummaryOk).toLocaleTimeString());
    } catch (error) {
      if (demoTimer) {            // preview mode: no summary API outside the dashboard
        renderSummary(buildDemoSummary());
        lastSummaryOk = Date.now();
        setSummaryStatus('Demo data, updated ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
        return;
      }
      const reason = error && error.name === 'AbortError' ? 'request timed out' : (error && error.message) || 'unknown error';
      const suffix = lastSummaryOk ? ', showing data from ' + new Date(lastSummaryOk).toLocaleTimeString() : '';
      setSummaryStatus('Unable to refresh: ' + reason + suffix, true);
    } finally {
      window.clearTimeout(timeout);
      summaryLoading = false;
    }
  }
  function setSummaryVisible(visible) {
    summaryEl.hidden = !visible;
    summaryToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(visible));
    pref.set('summaryVisible', visible);
    if (visible && Date.now() - lastSummaryOk >= SUMMARY_REFRESH_MS) loadSummary();
  }
  q('summary-hide').addEventListener('click', () => setSummaryVisible(false));
  summaryToggle.addEventListener('click', () => setSummaryVisible(summaryEl.hidden));
  const summaryTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
    if (!root.isConnected) { window.clearInterval(summaryTimer); return; }
    loadSummary();
  }, SUMMARY_REFRESH_MS);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (root.isConnected && !document.hidden && Date.now() - lastSummaryOk >= SUMMARY_REFRESH_MS) loadSummary();
  });

  /* ═════════════ start ═════════════ */
  const bootEl = q('cpms3d-boot');
  loadThree()
    .then((THREE) => {
      view3d = createScene(THREE);
      if (!bootEl.classList.contains('error')) bootEl.classList.add('hidden');
      if (pendingPayload) { const p = pendingPayload; pendingPayload = null; updateDashboardUI(p); }
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      console.error('CPMS 3D:', err);
      bootEl.classList.add('error');
      bootEl.textContent = (err && err.message ? err.message : 'The 3D view could not start.') +
        ' If this dashboard has no internet access, host three.min.js (r128) locally and set window.CPMS_THREE_URL.';
    });

  loadCore()
    .then(() => {
      connectTelemetry();
      const forceDemo = params.get('cpmsDemo') === '1' || demoTrip || window.CPMS_DEMO === true;
      if (forceDemo) startDemo();
      else if (!inGrafana) setTimeout(() => { if (!liveDataSeen) startDemo(); }, 3000);
      setSummaryVisible(pref.get('summaryVisible', true));
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      console.error('CPMS 3D:', err);
      setWsStatus('offline', 'Core missing');
      bootEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      bootEl.classList.add('error');
      bootEl.textContent = err.message + '. Copy cpms-core.js to the server\'s /custom/ folder (it holds the shared plant rules and telemetry connection).';
    });
})();
</script>
